items.description: Editable MoyaForge monaco-editor-react source. Components import their own CSS.
items.docs:
## MonacoEditorReact setup

`MonacoEditorReact` is a headless React Monaco runtime. It owns editor models, file drafts, worker integrations, language inference and read-only behavior, but it **does not render tabs, Copy, Save or toolbar controls**.

Install the Monaco runtime and optional UI workspace:

```sh
npm install @moyarich/moyaforge-monaco @moyarich/moyaforge-ui @monaco-editor/react monaco-editor
```

Import the visual workspace from `moyaforge-ui`:

```tsx
import { MonacoEditorPanel } from "@moyarich/moyaforge-ui/components/MonacoEditorPanel";

<MonacoEditorPanel
  files={files}
  onFileChange={(name, value) => setFiles(current => current.map(file => file.name === name ? { ...file, value } : file))}
  height={320}
/>;
```

For a custom shell, import `MonacoEditorReact` from `@moyarich/moyaforge-monaco/components/MonacoEditorReact` and pass an active file. The runtime does not take `onSave`, `showFileTabs`, or `showCopyButton`.

Configure workers once using `configureReactWorkers()` from `@moyarich/moyaforge-monaco/workers/configureReactWorkers`. When using TypeFox too, initialize the shared VS Code-compatible runtime via `initializeSharedMonaco()` from `@moyarich/moyaforge-monaco/runtime/initializeSharedMonaco` instead.

Guide and worker setup: https://github.com/moyarich/moyaforge/tree/main/packages/moyaforge-ui/docs/01-components/200-monaco-editor-react

items.docs:
# MonacoEditorTypeFox

Headless TypeFox Monaco runtime using VS Code services. Tabs, Save/Copy actions, breadcrumbs and visual editor layout are provided by `moyaforge-ui`, not by the runtime.

Install both the UI and the TypeFox runtime dependencies in your React application:

```sh
npm install @moyarich/moyaforge-ui @moyarich/moyaforge-monaco @typefox/monaco-editor-react@~8.0.2 monaco-languageclient@~11.0.2 @codingame/monaco-vscode-editor-api@^37.6.1
```

```tsx
import { TypeFoxEditorPanel } from "@moyarich/moyaforge-ui/components/TypeFoxEditorPanel";

<TypeFoxEditorPanel
  files={files}
  onFileChange={(name, value) => setFiles(current => current.map(file => file.name === name ? { ...file, value } : file))}
  height={320}
  showBreadcrumbs
/>;
```

For a fully custom shell, use the headless `MonacoEditorTypeFox` from `@moyarich/moyaforge-monaco/components/MonacoEditorTypeFox`. Its `languageClientConfig` forwards the optional `LanguageClientConfig` to the underlying editor. The host must provide the language server and transport.

Configure workers with `configureTypeFoxWorkers()` from `@moyarich/moyaforge-monaco/workers/configureTypeFoxWorkers`, or `initializeSharedMonaco()` from `@moyarich/moyaforge-monaco/runtime/initializeSharedMonaco` when using both editor integrations.
